name: Kidney
overview: The Scriptures highlight the kidneys as significant internal parts of sacrificial animals, specifically emphasized in the instructions for burnt offerings and consecration rituals. The fat covering the kidneys, along with the kidneys themselves and the caul above the liver, were to be removed and burned upon the altar as part of the sacred offerings to the LORD. This careful attention to the kidneys in offerings underscores their importance in the ritual purification and dedication processes prescribed in the Mosaic Law.
